result.instructions: Tools for StatusHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which services on our status page are down or degraded right now?"; "List the incidents from the last 30 days and how long each one lasted."; "Create a draft incident for the payments service with status down, without notifying subscribers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StatusHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run statushub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run statushub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run statushub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. statushub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: statushub_list_hubs
tools.title: List status pages
tools.description: List the status pages (hubs) this API key can see, with their subdomain. Call this first to find the subdomain that other tools need. Management API: GET /hubs.

type.description: primary = your own status pages; connected = connected status pages.

tools.name: statushub_get_hub
tools.title: Get a status page
tools.description: Get one status page: name, subdomain, type, custom domain and product URL. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_get_status_counters
tools.title: Get service status counters
tools.description: Count the services on a status page by current condition: up, degraded-performance and down. Good first call for "is anything broken now?". Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/status/counters.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services (components) on a status page, with their group and name. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/services.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

group_id.description: Only services in this group id.

archived.description: Archived services: true, false or all.

tools.name: statushub_get_service_statuses
tools.title: Get a service's status history
tools.description: Show the status changes of one service on a status page. Use the service id from statushub_list_services. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/status/services/{service_id}.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List the incidents on a status page, newest first by default. Filter by time range, affected service ids or service status. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/incidents.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

published.description: Published on the status page: true, false or all.

draft.description: Has an unpublished draft update: true, false or all.

archived.description: Archived incidents: true, false or all.

service_ids.description: Comma-separated service ids, e.g. 1,2,3. Matches incidents that affect at least one of them.

period_name.description: Comma-separated periods, e.g. current or past,current.

tools.name: statushub_get_incident
tools.title: Get an incident
tools.description: Get one incident: title, author, start and end time, and flags. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_list_incident_updates
tools.title: List incident updates
tools.description: List the updates posted on one incident (investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved). Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}/incident_updates.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_list_maintenances
tools.title: List maintenance events
tools.description: List planned maintenance events on a status page. Filter by draft state, time range or affected services. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/maintenances.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

draft.description: Not published yet: true, false or all.

period_name.description: Comma-separated periods, e.g. current or past,current.

tools.name: statushub_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get a maintenance event
tools.description: Get one maintenance event: title, start and end time, and affected services. Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_get_uptime
tools.title: Get status page uptime
tools.description: Get the uptime percentage of a whole status page for a date range (at most 18 months). Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/uptime.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_get_service_uptime
tools.title: Get service uptime
tools.description: Get the uptime percentage of one service for a date range (at most 18 months). Management API: GET /hubs/{subdomain}/uptime/services/{service_id}.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

tools.name: statushub_create_incident
tools.title: Create an incident
tools.description: Create an incident with its first update. The incident starts as a draft (not shown on the status page) and subscribers are not notified, unless you set state and silent. Management API: POST /hubs/{subdomain}/incidents.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2026-11-06T08:00:00Z. Cannot be in the future.

incident_type.description: Type of the first update. resolved is not allowed for the first update.

service_statuses.description: Affected services and their new status.

body.description: Text of the first update (plain text).

state.description: draft = not shown on the status page (default). unconfirmed or published = shown on the status page.

silent.description: true = subscribers are not notified (default). false = notify subscribers.

tools.name: statushub_create_incident_update
tools.title: Post an incident update
tools.description: Post a new update on an incident (investigating, identified, monitoring or resolved). It starts as a draft and subscribers are not notified, unless you set state and silent. A title that differs from the incident's current title RENAMES the incident. Management API: POST /hubs/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}/incident_updates.

hub.description: Status page (hub) subdomain, e.g. company-status. statushub_list_hubs returns them.

title.description: Plain-text title of this update. Use the incident's current title unless you want to rename the incident: a different title renames it.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC time, e.g. 2026-11-06T08:00:00Z. Cannot be in the future.

service_statuses.description: Affected services and their new status.

state.description: draft = not shown on the status page (default). unconfirmed or published = shown on the status page.

silent.description: true = subscribers are not notified (default). false = notify subscribers.
